ModMetaData.name: Kiiro Trade Patch
ModMetaData.author: Cancelation
ModMetaData.description:
绮罗商人优化： 本mod使绮罗商队和定居点只会出售和收购绮罗衣物。 可兼容绮罗衣物扩展与绮罗派系扩展（以 Kiiro 开头的派系自动生效，若绮罗派系未按照此规范命名其Def，会导致该补丁无法识别）。 本mod只硬性要求在原版绮罗mod后加载，但是如果有mod为绮罗族添加了新的衣物或派系，请将本mod放于此类mod之后。 注：对于绮罗的派系扩展没有进行太多测试，若存在bug，请在创意工坊中报告。
Makes Kiiro settlements and caravans buy Kiiro apparel while excluding all non-Kiiro apparel. Automatically compatible with Kiiro apparel extensions (new apparel under the Kiiro_Apparel category is bought automatically) and Kiiro faction extensions (factions whose defName starts with Kiiro are handled automatically). This mod only requires to be loaded after Kiiro Race, but if you have any mods that add new Kiiro apparel or factions, please load this mod after them. Note: The Kiiro faction extensions have not been comprehensively tested, please report any bugs in the workshop.
